repos.description: Map of org/repo keys to per-repository configuration.

checkout_directory.description: Relative path under DEVBENCH_WORKSPACE_ROOT for this repo's checkout.

branch_prefix.description: Per-repo task-branch prefix override. When set, task branches are named backlog/<prefix>/<unit-id-lower> instead of backlog/<unit-id-lower>. Overrides the top-level git_ops.branch_prefix for this repo. Must not be empty, have leading/trailing '/', or contain '..'.

commit_subject_template.description: Per-repo commit-subject template override. Placeholders: {unit_id}, {title}, {ticket} (the tracker id led by the work unit's **Branch:** field, e.g. SFB-229 from sfb-229-vendoring-pipeline). Overrides the top-level git_ops.commit_subject_template for this repo. Set this when the repo's own commit-msg hook enforces a subject shape the multi-dash work-unit ID cannot satisfy.

merge_strategy.description: Default PR merge strategy for all repos. Effective strategy at merge time resolves as: DEVBENCH_MERGE_STRATEGY env var > per-repo repos.<org/repo>.merge_strategy > this top-level value > 'squash'.

max_executor_retries.description: Maximum number of executor retry attempts per work unit when judge reviews fail. Default: 10.

max_executor_retries_per_judge.description: Optional per-judge override of max_executor_retries (issue #122). Keys must be in the canonical judge allowlist (REVIEW_JUDGE_NAMES + SECURITY_JUDGE_NAMES). Each value falls back to max_executor_retries when absent.

use_bedrock.description: Whether to route LLM calls through AWS Bedrock.

bedrock_region.description: AWS region for Bedrock API calls.

allowed_orgs.description: List of GitHub organisations permitted for operations.

display_timezone.description: IANA timezone name (e.g. 'America/New_York', 'Europe/London') applied by every devbench command that renders timestamps -- `devbench report`, `devbench hook-tail`, `devbench watch`, and any future command. When unset, each command defaults to the OS local timezone. Override per-invocation via the DEVBENCH_DISPLAY_TIMEZONE env var. Report-specific `report.display_timezone` / DEVBENCH_REPORT_TIMEZONE take precedence over this top-level setting for the report command only.

log_file.description: Workspace-relative path to the orchestrator's structured shared aggregate log file (for example 'logs/backlog-a-orchestrator.log'). When set, both `setup_logging` (the writer) and `cmd_report` (the reader) consult this single source of truth so the orchestrator and the report cannot read/write different files by accident. When unset, the default is '<DEFAULT_LOG_SUBDIR>/<DEFAULT_LOG_FILENAME>' (logs/orchestrator.log). Named sessions additionally write a per-session log at '.devbench/sessions/<name>/orchestrator.log' (read via 'report --session <name>'). Per-invocation override via the DEVBENCH_LOG_FILE env var still takes precedence (useful for tests).

gh_api.description: GitHub API call timeout in seconds.

test.description: Test suite run timeout in seconds.

security_fetch.description: Security advisory fetch timeout in seconds.

llm.description: LLM API call timeout in seconds.

command.description: Shell command execution timeout in seconds.

github_check.description: GitHub check status polling timeout in seconds.

orchestrator_inactivity.description: Orchestrator SDK message inactivity timeout in seconds -- bounds how long the cmd_start message loop waits for the next SDK message before treating the turn as hung (spec FR-17, db-262).

update_submodule.description: When true, update the parent repo's submodule reference after each PR merge. Set to true only when target repos are git submodules of a parent workspace repo.

single_branch.description: When set, all work units use this branch name instead of per-unit backlog/<id> branches. Enables accumulating multiple commits on one branch for a single PR.

commit_subject_template.description: Template for the commit subject git-ops writes, overridden per-repo by repos.<org/repo>.commit_subject_template. Placeholders: {unit_id}, {title}, {ticket} (the tracker id led by the work unit's **Branch:** field, e.g. SFB-229 from sfb-229-vendoring-pipeline). Default: unset, which keeps the subject '<unit-id>: <title>'. A template naming {ticket} fails loudly when a work unit's branch carries no tracker id.

branch_prefix.description: Top-level task-branch prefix, overridden per-repo by repos.<org/repo>.branch_prefix. When set, task branches are named backlog/<prefix>/<unit-id-lower> instead of backlog/<unit-id-lower>; also namespaces single_branch as <prefix>/<single_branch> when both are set. Namespaces branches by workspace so multiple devbench work groups sharing one downstream repo never collide on branch names. Default: unset (no prefix). Must not be empty, have leading/trailing '/', or contain '..'.

defer_pr.description: When true, git-ops commits locally only (no push, no PR, no merge). Use git-ops-finalize to push and create the PR after all work units are complete. Only meaningful when single_branch is set.

pause_before_merge.description: When true, cmd_git_ops pushes the PR and waits for green CI then transitions the work unit to in-review instead of merging; the orchestrator's loop reconciles in-review tasks via cmd_check_merge on the next iteration. Issue #101. Default false. Mutually exclusive with defer_pr: true and single_branch: <name> (validated at config load).

inline_orphan_cleanup.description: When true (the default), cmd_git_ops runs cleanup_tracked_orphans inline as a devbench-authored chore commit before the task's commit when build/state orphan paths are detected. When false, falls back to the legacy proposal-task path. Phase 1 of the orphan-cascade fix. Override via DEVBENCH_INLINE_ORPHAN_CLEANUP.

ci_failure_retry.description: When true (the default), cmd_git_ops returns rc=2 on CI failure to trigger an executor retry with the failing-job log as feedback. When false, returns rc=1 BLOCKED on the first CI failure (legacy behaviour). Issue #115. Override via DEVBENCH_CI_FAILURE_RETRY_ENABLED.

orphan_patterns.description: Operator override of the built-in orphan-pattern fnmatch list (terraform state, terragrunt cache, Python pycache, coverage, etc.). When non-empty, REPLACES the built-in list entirely. Override via DEVBENCH_ORPHAN_IGNORE_PATTERNS. Default: [] (use the built-in list).

local_only.description: When true, the target repo(s) are treated as local-only -- no origin git remote, never pushed, no PRs, no CI. ensure_branch creates the work-unit branch off the local default branch (no 'git fetch origin'). Requires defer_pr: true, forbids pause_before_merge: true, and requires every entry in repos: to set an explicit default_branch:. Used for operational workflows (AWS teardowns, evidence capture, audits) where devbench drives work but does not edit application code. Default: false.

auto_finalize.description: When true, the orchestrate skill automatically invokes 'devbench git-ops-finalize <repo>' once all work units for the repo are terminal. Requires defer_pr: true. Incompatible with local_only: true (no remote to push to). A marker file at <workspace>/.devbench/auto-finalize-fired-<repo>.marker prevents duplicate invocations. Default: false.

auto_merge.description: When true, the orchestrate skill automatically invokes 'gh pr merge --<merge_strategy>' once the post-E7 CI watcher reports GREEN. Requires auto_finalize: true AND defer_pr: true. Incompatible with local_only: true. When the E7 watcher is absent, emits [AUTO_MERGE_SKIPPED] no_ci_watcher and skips. A marker file at <workspace>/.devbench/auto-merge-fired-<repo>.marker prevents duplicate invocations. Default: false.

pr_review_resolution.description: PR review-comment polling settings (issue #116). Disabled by default. When enabled, cmd_git_ops polls gh pr view for asynchronous bot review feedback (Copilot, Q-Dev, internal review bots) before merging.

enabled.description: Top-level toggle. When false (default), the entire phase is a no-op. Override via DEVBENCH_PR_REVIEW_RESOLUTION_ENABLED.

agents.description: Comma-separated allowlist of GitHub login names whose unresolved review comments block the merge. Empty default; populate when review bots are configured on the target repo. Override via DEVBENCH_PR_REVIEW_AGENTS.

decision_blocks.description: When true (default), reviewDecision == CHANGES_REQUESTED hard-blocks the merge regardless of bot allowlist. Override via DEVBENCH_PR_REVIEW_DECISION_BLOCKS.

settle_seconds.description: Total settle-window length in seconds for the PR review poll loop. Default 60. Override via DEVBENCH_PR_REVIEW_SETTLE_SECONDS.

poll_interval.description: Per-poll cadence in seconds inside the settle window. Default 5. Override via DEVBENCH_PR_REVIEW_POLL_INTERVAL.

isolate_worktrees.description: Claim each work unit into its own git worktree beside the primary checkout instead of sharing one working tree. Two units that never share a tree never collide, so an interrupted unit's uncommitted work is not something the next claim has to displace. Mutually exclusive with single_branch: git allows a branch to be checked out in exactly one worktree at a time. Default: false.

max_blocks.description: Maximum consecutive stop-hook blocks before circuit breaker trips and allows stop. Default: 5.

window_seconds.description: Time window in seconds for counting stop-hook blocks. Counter resets after this period. Default: 180.

stale_task_minutes.description: Minutes before an in-progress task is considered stale. Hook warns instead of blindly blocking. Default: 120.

hook_tail.description: devbench hook-tail column-cap settings (issue #134). EVENT_WIDTH stays a hook_tail.py-local constant; the four below are the operator-tunable knobs.

agent_width.description: Column width for the agent name. Default: 12.

tool_width.description: Column width for the tool name. Default: 8.

description_max.description: Max chars for the description column. Default: 120 (bumped from 100 in the release that introduces this block).

stdout_preview_max.description: Max chars for the result-preview column after the pipe. Default: 80.

max_cascade_depth.description: Cap on recovery-of-a-recovery cascade depth. When a proposal would land at depth >= this cap, the source task transitions to NEEDS_OPERATOR_ATTENTION instead of materialising another recovery layer. Default: 2.

max_transport_restarts.description: Cap on consecutive in-process restarts after an SDK transport error. Unlike a quota window or an inactivity timeout, a transport fault imposes no natural delay, so this bound is deliberately low and separate from max_quota_resumes: exhausting it means the transport is down, not flapping, and the run fails fast. Default: 10.

transport_restart_backoff_base_seconds.description: First delay, in seconds, before the initial transport restart. Each subsequent restart doubles it (base * 2 ** restarts_used) up to transport_restart_backoff_max_seconds. Default: 1.0.

transport_restart_backoff_max_seconds.description: Ceiling, in seconds, on the exponential transport-restart delay. Must be >= transport_restart_backoff_base_seconds. Default: 60.0.

effort.description: Reasoning effort for the orchestrator SDK session and every agent it spawns. Unset, the session inherits the ambient Claude Code effort, so an unattended run's cost profile depends on whatever the operator's last interactive session used. Default: high.

max_thinking_tokens.description: Ceiling on how many tokens one turn may spend reasoning. A turn that reasons for longer than the prompt-cache lifetime returns to a cold cache, so the whole prompt is re-uploaded and re-cached instead of read back, and the run reaches its quota limit sooner. Default: 16000.

alert_summary.description: Maximum number of security alert summaries to include.

output_truncation.description: Character limit for command output truncation.

llm_evidence_truncation.description: Character limit for LLM evidence content truncation.

llm_file_context.description: Maximum number of files included in LLM context.

llm_file_preview_chars.description: Character limit for per-file LLM preview.

ci_failure_log_bytes.description: Byte cap for the trimmed failing-job log written to .devbench/ci-failures/<id>-<n>.log when ci_failure_retry is enabled. Default 32768. Override via DEVBENCH_CI_FAILURE_LOG_BYTES.

debug.description: Diagnostic-tuning knobs. Set these only when investigating a specific orchestrator-cadence problem; production workspaces leave this section absent.

check_registration_retries.description: Number of times wait_for_checks retries gh pr checks when 'no checks reported' contradicts the local workflow-file glob (issue #114 race-defence). Default 12. Override via DEVBENCH_CHECK_REGISTRATION_RETRIES.

check_registration_delay_seconds.description: Sleep between check-registration retries, in seconds. Default 5. Override via DEVBENCH_CHECK_REGISTRATION_DELAY_SECONDS.

blocked_recovery_window_seconds.description: Recency cap for the AWAITING_AUTO_RECOVERY signal in the 3-state blocked-task classifier. Tasks whose most recent [BLOCKED] audit-comment timestamp is older than this window fall through to NEEDS_OPERATOR_ATTENTION. Default 1800. Override via DEVBENCH_BLOCKED_RECOVERY_WINDOW_SECONDS.

report.description: Report and cost estimation settings. Issue #223: the legacy scalar token_cost_per_million_input / token_cost_per_million_output / token_cost_discount fields were retired in favour of a per-model rate table. Workspaces that still set the old fields get a fail-fast error at config-load time.

models.description: Per-model token-pricing table (issue #223). Each key is a Claude model id (matches the literal `message.model` field in transcripts, e.g. `claude-opus-4-7`). Operators add new model ids without code changes by listing them here. See docs/model-pricing.md for the default rate table.

additionalProperties.description: Rates for a single model. `input` and `output` are required. The four optional fields override the top-level `cache_*_multiplier` defaults and the global correction factor for this model only.

input.description: Cost per million input tokens in USD.

output.description: Cost per million output tokens in USD.

cache_read_multiplier.description: Optional per-model override for cache-read multiplier (relative to input rate). When omitted, the top-level report.cache_read_multiplier applies.

cache_write_5min_multiplier.description: Optional per-model override for 5-min cache-write multiplier.

cache_write_1hr_multiplier.description: Optional per-model override for 1-hour cache-write multiplier.

correction_factor.description: Per-model contract correction factor (issue #223). Computed cost is multiplied by this value after every other factor. Default 1.0 (no correction). Set via `devbench cost-calibrate <actual-usd>` rather than hand-editing in most workflows.

default_model.description: Rates applied to the `<unknown>` bucket: any transcript message whose `model` field is missing OR a model id not present in `report.models`. When absent, falls back to the Opus 5 list rates (issue #233) so unknown models err toward over-reporting cost.

display_timezone.description: IANA timezone name (e.g. 'America/Denver', 'Europe/London') for displaying timestamps in `devbench report`. Defaults to the host system's local timezone. Useful when running inside a devcontainer or VM whose system TZ differs from your actual location. Override via DEVBENCH_REPORT_TIMEZONE env var.

cache_read_multiplier.description: Cost multiplier for cache-read tokens, relative to base input rate. Defaults to 0.10 (Anthropic's published rate). Override only when running on a platform with different caching pricing (e.g. some Bedrock configurations).

cache_write_5min_multiplier.description: Cost multiplier for 5-minute prompt-cache write tokens, relative to base input rate. Defaults to 1.25 (Anthropic's published rate).

cache_write_1hr_multiplier.description: Cost multiplier for 1-hour prompt-cache write tokens, relative to base input rate. Defaults to 2.0 (Anthropic's published rate).

data_residency_multiplier.description: Cost multiplier applied per-call to usage.inference_geo-flagged tokens (issue #124). Defaults to 1.10 (Anthropic's published rate). Composes with cache + base-rate multipliers and applies before token_cost_discount.

fast_mode_multiplier.description: Cost multiplier applied per-call to usage.speed=='fast' tokens (issue #124). Defaults to 2.0 (Opus 5 / Opus 4.8 fast-mode premium, captured 2026-07-28, issue #233). Composes with cache + base-rate multipliers and applies before token_cost_discount.

recent_pace_tasks.description: Number of most-recently-completed tasks averaged for the 'Recent pace' projection in `devbench report`. Defaults to 10. Lower for more responsiveness, higher for more stability. Override via DEVBENCH_REPORT_RECENT_PACE_TASKS env var.

token_cost_per_million_input.description: REMOVED in issue #223 (per-model cost pricing). Schema-accepts the key so the runtime fail-fast in config_loader.py can name the new `report.models` block in its error message; setting this key produces an immediate ValueError pointing at docs/model-pricing.md.

token_cost_discount.description: REMOVED in issue #223. Per-model contract correction is now expressed via `report.models.<id>.correction_factor`.

manifest_amendment.description: Configuration for the Changes Manifest amendment workflow (enabled by default). When enabled, executors that discover a required production fix during TDD GREEN can request an amendment to the Changes Manifest; a dedicated judge reviews the request, and on approval the manifest is updated atomically with a Layer 3 deterministic post-check.

enabled.description: Whether the amendment workflow is active for this backlog. Default true (set false to opt out).

allowed_reasons.description: List of amendment reasons this backlog accepts. Amendment requests whose reason is not in this list are rejected by the Layer 1 pre-filter. 'doc_sync_review_fix' is restricted to documentation (.md) or documentation-pinning test paths. Default: ['tdd_green_production_fix', 'doc_sync_review_fix'].

max_requests_per_execution.description: Maximum amendments applied to one task during one executor run. Default 2, which admits one addition plus one row removal so a unit can satisfy AC-FINAL-015 in both directions within a single run. Prevents amendment loops.

backlog.description: Backlog lifecycle settings. Controls how new work units are created, what default status they receive (issue #189), and bulk-operation thresholds (issue #194).

default_status_for_new_work_units.description: Lifecycle status written into the '## Status:' line of every newly created work-unit file. Use 'draft' to require explicit human promotion before the orchestrator picks up the task. Use 'in-queue' (the default) for the legacy behaviour where new tasks are picked up immediately. AC-189-8 and AC-189-9.

bulk_update_confirm_threshold.description: Number of work units above which devbench set-status with selector flags prompts for confirmation before applying a bulk status change. Zero means always prompt. Default: 10. AC-194-4.

bulk_update_audit_path.description: Workspace-relative path to the file where bulk-update audit rows are appended. Default: 'logs/bulk-updates.log'. AC-194-7.

task_factory.description: Configuration for the task-factory loop, on by default (ADR-32, superseding the PR #202 shipped auto-promote-by-default posture, not ADR-11). When enabled, the orchestrator invokes blocker-resolver + task-factory after an amendment reject to materialise new draft work-unit files for the out-of-scope production fixes the amender surfaced; a draft's initial status is governed by backlog.default_status_for_new_work_units (default in-queue), unrelated to auto_accept_proposals. Requires manifest_amendment.enabled: true (a config that omits this block while explicitly disabling manifest_amendment.enabled downgrades silently to disabled rather than failing config-load; an explicit enabled: true against a disabled amendment workflow still fails fast).

enabled.description: Whether the task-factory loop runs after amendment rejects. Default true (on by default, ADR-32). Requires manifest_amendment.enabled: true. Set false to opt out.

auto_accept_proposals.description: Governs two auto-promote paths. (1) write-proposal: when true, write-proposal synchronously also calls materialise-proposal (and promote-proposal for any just-written id already sitting at legacy status `proposed`) in the same invocation, so drafts land immediately instead of waiting for the next sweep-proposals tick; when false (the default), write-proposal only persists the JSON and materialisation happens later via sweep-proposals or a manual materialise-proposal call. (2) sweep-proposals: when true, it also auto-promotes any draft explicitly sitting at status `proposed` (a legacy/hand-edited-draft case; the normal materialise path never writes that status -- it always uses backlog.default_status_for_new_work_units). Neither path changes the initial status of a freshly materialised draft. Default false (ADR-32). Only takes effect when task_factory.enabled is true.

validate.description: Toggles for additional validate-backlog rules. Existing rules (1-19) run unconditionally; the rules listed here are individually toggleable.

check_orphan_path_tokens.description: Rule 20: cross-check Acceptance Criteria and Definition of Done sections of every Task against the Changes Manifest. Backtick-quoted path-shaped tokens that do not appear in the Manifest (and are not declared read-only via a trailing `(ref)` marker) emit an integrity error. Catches spec drift where AC/DoD prose restates a path that disagrees with the Manifest. Default true (set false to opt out). See docs/backlog-contract.md.

production_source_paths.description: Path prefixes this workspace treats as production source for the task-type invariant (rule 21) and source-test atomicity (rule 14). Absent preserves the built-in prefixes 'src/' and 'infra/scripts/' plus any nested '/src/' segment. Set this when a repository keeps tested production modules elsewhere, for example a monorepo whose control plane lives in 'scripts/'. Test paths and __init__.py are excluded regardless. See docs/backlog-contract.md 'Task-Type Taxonomy'.

production_source_extensions.description: File extensions this workspace treats as production source, consumed with production_source_paths by the task-type invariant (rule 21) and source-test atomicity (rule 14). Absent keeps the built-in Python-only behaviour. Declare it when behaviour lives in non-Python artefacts, for example an infrastructure repo whose service specs are YAML and whose modules are HCL, so those changes are RED-gated instead of being forced to task type 'chore'.

audit_trail_paths.description: Path prefixes every task type may declare in its Changes Manifest regardless of its task-type invariant (rule 21). Absent means no such prefix exists and the invariant is unchanged. Declare it when the target repository requires each ticket to carry an audit-trail record, for example ['.ai-sdlc/']: that record is neither production source, nor a test, nor documentation, so no existing classifier accepts it, yet a docs task and a chore task must both be able to own one. See docs/backlog-contract.md 'Task-Type Taxonomy'.

skills.description: Plugin-skill (spec-to-backlog, create-spec) operator-facing configuration. Lets operators point the skills at their own workspace exemplars (a representative backlog and a representative spec) rather than a hardcoded built-in path, plus tune the fan-out and iteration budget. All fields are optional; absent values fall through to skill-side defaults (issue #221 E1-E10).

exemplar_backlog_path.description: Absolute or workspace-relative path to a representative BACKLOG.md the spec-to-backlog skill consults to internalise the project's quality bar. Optional; when absent the skill falls back to the canonical-section list embedded in its prompt rather than reading any exemplar file. Operators set this when they have a richer in-workspace exemplar than the embedded section list.

exemplar_spec_path.description: Absolute or workspace-relative path to a representative spec file the create-spec skill consults to internalise the project's quality bar. Optional; when absent the skill falls back to the 16-section structural skeleton embedded in its prompt rather than reading any exemplar file.

fan_out_threshold.description: When the Epic decomposition yields more than this many leaf tasks, the spec-to-backlog skill fans the per-task authoring out across one Agent invocation per Feature instead of writing tasks serially. Default 10. Set higher to keep the work serial on small workspaces; set lower to fan out aggressively on large ones.

max_iterations.description: Maximum self-critique iterations per skill invocation. When exceeded, the skill emits a [SKILL_MAX_ITERATIONS_REACHED] audit comment with the unresolved rubric items instead of silently shipping a sub-quality artefact. Default 5.

notifications.description: Operator-facing notifications fired on lifecycle events. Each event under 'events' is independently toggled. Each notification endpoint (Slack today; Discord/Teams/etc. later) lives in its own nested sub-block so new transports can be added without touching the event-toggle surface. See docs/slack-notifications.md.

enabled.description: Master switch. When false, no event fires regardless of per-event toggles. Default: false.

timeout_seconds.description: Per-POST HTTP timeout in seconds. Default 10.

events.description: Per-event toggles. Every field defaults to false so the dispatcher is silent until the operator opts in.

work_unit_done.description: Fire when a work unit transitions to done. Default: false.

work_unit_blocked_operator.description: Fire when the classifier flags a blocked WU as OPERATOR_ACTION_REQUIRED. Fires on every transition into that class (initial entry + reclassification). Default: false.

work_unit_blocked_runtime_degradation.description: Fire when the classifier flags a blocked WU as RUNTIME_DEGRADATION (SDK Agent-tool loss; requires 'make start' restart). Default: false.

work_unit_blocked_held.description: Fire when the classifier flags a blocked WU as HELD (status is 'hold'; operator must resume manually). Default: false.

work_unit_blocked_on_held.description: Fire when the classifier flags a blocked WU as BLOCKED_ON_HELD (marker target is in 'hold'; operator must resume the held target). Default: false.

work_unit_blocked_auto_clearing.description: Fire when the classifier flags a blocked WU as AUTO_CLEARING_VIA_PROPOSAL (ADR-07 cascade in flight; will auto-unblock). Default: false.

work_unit_blocked_awaiting_dependency.description: Fire when the classifier flags a blocked WU as AWAITING_DEPENDENCY (regular dep still in flight; will auto-unblock). Default: false.

work_unit_blocked_amendment_recovery.description: Fire when the classifier flags a blocked WU as AWAITING_AMENDMENT_RECOVERY (recovery signal on disk; will resume on next sweep). Default: false.

work_unit_materialised.description: Fire when a draft WU file is materialised from a proposal. Default: false.

work_unit_promoted.description: Fire when a draft WU is promoted to in-queue. Default: false.

pr_opened.description: Fire when 'gh pr create' succeeds. Default: false.

pr_merged.description: Fire when 'gh pr merge' succeeds. Default: false.

ci_failure.description: Fire when CI checks on a WU PR fail. Default: false.

ci_pass.description: Fire when CI checks on the finalize-path batch PR turn green (PR ready for manual merge under auto_merge: false). Issue #219. Default: false.

orchestrator_stop.description: Fire when the orchestrator loop exits (clean, drain, SIGTERM, or crash). Default: false.

orchestrator_auto_restart.description: Fire when the orchestrator exits 42 (RUNTIME_DEGRADATION-only NO_ACTIONABLE) and the Makefile loop restarts. Default: false.

quota_waiting.description: Fire when the orchestrator hits a quota and starts waiting for it to reset (payload carries the quota source/reason and the provider-stated reset time). Wired by E2-F3-S1-T1; the key is inert until then. Default: false.

quota_resumed.description: Fire when the quota recovers and the run resumes (payload carries the total seconds waited). Wired by E2-F3-S1-T1; the key is inert until then. Default: false.

slack.description: Slack endpoint. ONE webhook URL is shared by every event; the payload itself carries an <!here> mention so the same payload works whether the webhook is bound to a one-person private DM channel or a shared team channel.

enabled.description: Endpoint-level toggle. When false, no Slack POST fires regardless of the master switch or per-event toggles. Default: false.

webhook_url.description: Slack incoming webhook URL (https://hooks.slack.com/...). null disables Slack notifications. Env override: DEVBENCH_NOTIFICATIONS_SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL.

agents.description: Per-agent model overrides (ADR-25). Each field defaults to null; the agent then runs on the model declared in its .md frontmatter. Set a field to override for this workspace -- devbench materialises a workspace-local shadow plugin tree under <workspace>/.devbench/plugin-shadow/devbench/ and rewrites the matching frontmatter line. JUDGE_AGENT_MODEL_<NAME> env vars override these YAML values. Use short names (opus|sonnet|fable) or full Anthropic model ids (claude-opus-5) when use_bedrock: false; use the matching Bedrock id (us.anthropic.claude-opus-5-v1) when use_bedrock: true. Note: 'haiku' is not an accepted short name -- haiku is rejected for every work agent at config-load time (caylent-solutions/devbench#198).

review_team.description: Per-judge overrides for the four review_team agents. Each field defaults to null; the corresponding judge then runs on its frontmatter model.

quota_handling.description: Quota wait-and-resume configuration (issue #236, spec S5.2). Default: enabled=true.

enabled.description: Master toggle. true (default) enables wait-and-resume. false restores the legacy non-zero exit (#193 AC-4, spec AC-24).

on_exhaustion.description: Action when a quota signal is detected. Default: 'wait'.

poll_interval_seconds.description: Recovery probe cadence in seconds. Default: 60.

max_wait_seconds.description: Maximum total wait in seconds before on_exhaustion_timeout fires. Default: 18000 (5 hours).

on_exhaustion_timeout.description: Action when max_wait_seconds elapses without recovery. Default: 'drain'.

resume_strategy.description: How to resume after successful recovery. Default: 'continue_current_wu'.

audit_comment_on_wait.description: Append [QUOTA_WAITING] audit comment to the in-progress WU. Default: true.

audit_comment_on_resume.description: Append [QUOTA_RESUMED] audit comment after recovery. Default: true.

log_structured_events.description: Emit structured log events on quota transitions. Default: true.
